requirements.evidence: Data model matches the spec: entities slug unique 'entities_slug_unique' (create_entities_table.php:17), owner_seq storedAs + 'entity_memberships_one_owner' (create_entity_memberships_table.php:20-22). Models, enum with manageable(), factories with owner/admin/employee states, both policies, the current_entity alias (bootstrap/app.php:17-19), /home dispatch (routes/web.php:22-39), pick with 403 + audit log (routes/web.php:53-68), switcher markup with data-current="1" (switcher.blade.php:6-10), navbar link only when count > 1, and lang keys in both locales are all present. CreateEntity retries on slug collisions and calls uniqueSlug() on every attempt (CreateEntity.php:32-57). Gaps: /home calls Entity::find() and does not handle null, so a soft-deleted entity breaks the redirect (routes/web.php:33-35). A stale session pointing at a deleted entity aborts 403 forever and is never cleared (ResolveCurrentEntity.php:38-41).

conventions.evidence: The domain write (entity + owner membership) sits inline in the Livewire component (CreateEntity.php:37-50). Conventions say 'Domain writes go through app/Actions/*'. entity.pick checks membership by hand ('if ($user->membershipFor($entity->id) === null) abort(403)') instead of going through the EntityPolicy it just added. Routes are closures with logic in routes/web.php. The custom current_entity middleware is not registered with Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware (Livewire policy rule 6). There are no tests, which breaks the mandatory TDD rule. Positives: #[Validate] + $this->validate(), $fillable set on both models, docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG updated, Bulma markup.

security.evidence: CreateEntity validates name and authorizes create, and the role is hard-coded to UserRole::Owner (CreateEntity.php:18,24-26,46). Dashboard authorizes 'view' on the bound entity in mount (Dashboard.php:16), so a valid session for another entity still gets 403. Pick checks membership before touching the session. Output uses {{ }}. Minor gaps: current_entity is not a persistent Livewire middleware, and entity creation is not rate-limited. Dashboard has no actions, so the impact is limited.

tests.evidence: The diff has no test files. Nothing covers the migrations/unique constraints, policies, middleware dispatch, /home, pick, switcher, navbar or the CreateEntity slug retry. The Livewire unauthorized-call and tamper tests that the conventions require are also missing.

simplicity.evidence: The 0/1/>1 dispatch logic is duplicated between ResolveCurrentEntity.php:51-71 and routes/web.php:23-38. The entity-loading block is duplicated inside the middleware (lines 43-46 and 63-67). The resolved entity is stored three ways (Tenant::set, request attributes, app()->instance). Role checks are copy-pasted across EntityPolicy update/delete and EntityMembershipPolicy. isDuplicateSlugError matches on exception message strings (CreateEntity.php:89-96).

readability.evidence: Clear names and small classes, and the models have typed relations with PHPDoc. Weak spots: the 'while (true)' retry loop with an attempts counter in submit() (CreateEntity.php:32-57) is somewhat dense, and the closure routes bury business logic in routes/web.php.

scope.evidence: Every file serves the task. No members/settings pages, locale middleware or navbar redesign were added. The docs edits are limited to entities/memberships.

issues.explanation: The change ships no Pest/PHPUnit tests at all, against the mandatory TDD convention and the Livewire definition of done (unauthorized and tamper tests).
Entity creation plus the owner membership is a domain write done inline in the component, not in an app/Actions/CreateEntity class that authorizes internally.
entity.pick authorizes with a manual membership check and abort(403) instead of $this->authorize/Gate with the new EntityPolicy::view, and its logic lives in a route closure.
The custom current_entity middleware is not registered via Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware, so it stops applying on Livewire update requests (Livewire policy rule 6).
Entity::find() can return null for a soft-deleted entity, and then the redirect to entity.dashboard fails because the route parameter is missing.
When the session entity was deleted, the user gets a permanent 403 and the stale session is never cleared or re-dispatched.
The membership-count dispatch is duplicated, and the entity is stored in three places (Tenant, request attributes, container).
Duplicate-slug detection by substring-matching the exception message is brittle; checking the SQLSTATE/error code would be more robust.

review.summary: The change implements the entities data model with DB-enforced single owner, the policies, the tenant middleware, onboarding with slug-collision retry, the switcher, the dashboard and the navbar link, and it largely meets the functional contract. It ships no tests at all, which violates the mandatory TDD convention. It also bypasses the Actions pattern for the domain write, authorizes pick by hand instead of through the policy, and does not persist the custom middleware for Livewire, so it needs substantial rework before merging.
